description: SKILL-02: the v1 pending rule, through the real loop. Turn 1 authors a candidate; turn 2 asks for a DIFFERENT adaptation while that one is still pending. The writer refuses without patching, superseding or archiving, so the thread ends with exactly ONE immutable row — not two versions, and not turn 1's row silently rewritten to turn 2's text. The EXACT same-turn retry (same thread, same turn id) is covered deterministically in skills.test.ts; only a live loop can produce two genuinely different turns.
